title: Basic Science practice
subject: basic_science

review: Sample: to be reviewed by a Basic Science teacher before testing with learners.

questions.question: Which part of the body do we use to smell?
Which of these is a living thing?
questions.explanation: A goat is alive. It eats, grows and breathes.

questions.question: What do plants need to grow?
questions.explanation: Plants need water and sunlight to grow.

questions.question: What gives us light and heat in the day?
questions.explanation: The sun gives us light and heat.

questions.question: Which part of the body do we use to hear?
Which of these can we eat?
questions.explanation: Rice is food. We can eat it.

questions.question: What falls from the clouds when it rains?
questions.explanation: Rain is water falling from the clouds.

questions.question: Why do we wash our hands before we eat?
questions.explanation: Washing our hands removes germs that can make us sick.
